skills.name: Whack the Dimwit
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to attack up to 4 times, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
Performing other actions with Rina during Drusilla and Anastella's attacks will not interrupt Rina's Basic Attack combo count.

skills.name: Shoo the Fool
skills.desc:
Hold [Basic Attack] or [Special Attack] to activate:
Calls back Drusilla and Anastella to swing them around for a ranged attack, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: Dress Adjustment
skills.desc:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A rapid dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Sudden Surprise
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to execute a piercing attack, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Bangboo Callback
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward and trigger an explosion, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Duple Meter Allemande
skills.desc:
When the character on field is launched, press [Assist] to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward and trigger an explosion, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Triple Meter Courante
skills.desc:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Assist] to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Quadruple Meter Gavotte
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to push forward and generate an electrical vortex, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Beat the Blockhead
skills.desc:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Order Anastella to execute a downward smash, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: Dimwit Disappearing Trick
skills.desc:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Order Anastella to execute multiple downward smashes, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

skills.name: Code of Conduct
skills.desc:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to push forward and generate a ball-shaped electrical field that deals massive Electric DMG.
During this skill, Drusilla and Anastella are unable to perform Basic Attacks, Dash Attacks, Special Attacks, and EX Special Attacks, but can be recalled to Rina's side through Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

skills.name: The Queen's Attendants
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward, dealing massive Electric DMG.
During this skill, Drusilla and Anastella are unable to respond to Basic Attack, Dash Attack, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack commands, but can be recalled to Rina's side through Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool.
Upon activating this skill, the other squad members recover 10 Energy. The next character to switch in recovers an additional 20 Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

skills.name: Mini Destruction Partner
skills.desc: When ordering Drusilla or Anastella to attack, other squad members' PEN Ratio increases together with Rina's, by 25% of Rina's PEN Ratio + 6%, up to 30%. The effect ends when both Drusilla and Anastella return to Rina.

skills.name: Banquet of Perfection
skills.desc: When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction: Increases the duration of Shock inflicted on enemies by any character by 3s. When Shocked enemies are on the field, all squad members' Electric DMG increases by 10%.

cons.name: Dance Duet
cons.desc:
After being sent out to launch an attack, Drusilla and Anastella stay in place for an additional 5.5s before returning to Rina.
The buff gained from Core Passive: Mini Destruction Partner by characters within 10m is increased to 130%.

cons.name: Master's Paragon
cons.desc: Upon entering combat or switching in, Rina's DMG increases by 15% for 12s. This effect can trigger once every 18s.

cons.name: Head Maid's Specialty
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Needle and Hammer
cons.desc:
Rina's Energy Regen increases by 0.5/s when both Drusilla and Anastella are deployed.
The effect ends when Drusilla or Anastella returns to Rina.

cons.name: Head Maid Perfectionist
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv.+2

cons.name: Stormy Night's Fright
cons.desc: When EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate hits an enemy, the entire squad’s Electric DMG is increased by 15% for 8s.

main: 暴击率、攻击力百分比、异常精通
